name: Full Color Custom Yard Sign
descriptionHtml:
Promote your message effectively with our Full Color Custom Yard Sign, a durable and professional solution for outdoor advertising, real estate, events, and political or business promotions. Printed in full color on rigid 4mm coroplast, this yard sign delivers vibrant visuals while standing up to outdoor conditions.

Each sign measures 24” × 18” and comes ready to use, including metal stakes, professional setup, and delivery at no extra cost. Designed for quick installation, it’s an easy and affordable way to get your message in front of customers fast.

🔹 Key Features

🪧 Full Color Custom Printing – High-quality, vibrant graphics
📏 Standard Size – 24" × 18" yard sign
🧱 Durable Material – 4mm corrugated coroplast
🌦️ Outdoor Ready – Weather-resistant for long-term use
🔩 Metal Stakes Included – Easy ground installation
🎨 Design & Setup Included – No additional setup fees
🚚 Delivery Included – Hassle-free shipping to your location

🔹 Imprint Method

🖨️ Full-Color Digital Printing

🔹 Materials

🧱 Sign Material: 4mm Coroplast
🔩 Stakes: Metal

🔹 What’s Included

📦 Full Color Custom Yard Sign (24×18)
🔩 Metal Stake
🎨 Design Setup
🚚 Delivery

🔹 Primary Usage

Outdoor advertising, real estate signage, events, political campaigns, business promotions, construction sites, and directional signage.

Warranty

We stand behind the quality of our products. Our warranty covers any factory defects or damage that occurs during shipping. However, please note that we do not cover damage resulting from extreme weather conditions, misuse, or any circumstances beyond our control.
